content.text: 신호 최적화 완료. 결과를 비교 분석합니다.

input.query: SELECT simulation_id, description, vehicle_count, created_at FROM simulations ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 2

SELECT 
  simulation_id,
  AVG(duration)/60 as avg_duration_min,
  AVG(waitingTime)/60 as avg_wait_min,
  AVG(timeLoss)/60 as avg_loss_min,
  COUNT(*) as completed
FROM trips 
WHERE simulation_id IN ('sim_20260325_015925_479', 'sim_20260325_020044_977') AND arrival > 0
GROUP BY simulation_id
ORDER BY simulation_id

SELECT 
  e1.edge_id,
  AVG(e1.density) as baseline_density,
  AVG(e2.density) as optimized_density,
  (AVG(e2.density) - AVG(e1.density)) as density_change
FROM edge_metrics e1
JOIN edge_metrics e2 ON e1.edge_id = e2.edge_id AND e1.interval_begin = e2.interval_begin
WHERE e1.simulation_id = 'sim_20260325_015925_479' 
  AND e2.simulation_id = 'sim_20260325_020044_977'
GROUP BY e1.edge_id
HAVING AVG(e1.density) > 200
ORDER BY baseline_density DESC
LIMIT 10
